value.rationale: The two-parameter graph family contains the star-to-nontrivial-clique transition: stars and complete graphs remain positive for arbitrary h, whereas any genuine multiple-clique windmill loses positivity after a unique finite, explicitly solvable step horizon, and precisely the within-blade transitions become negative. This gives a meaningful structural timestep cutoff for preserving nonnegative diffusion on hub-and-community networks, not an arbitrary small example.
